BLOCKING_FINDING.root_cause: escalate-catalog.js:21-23 — `const nfNode = $('not-found-error-message'); … response = nf.escalate_message;`. It re-sources escalate_message BY NAME from the node UPSTREAM of the dym chain, so it reads the PRE-annotation copy. build-suggest-offer correctly spreads rather than mutating its input, so its annotated output is never consumed on this path. compile-current-state then does `userResponse = response` (line 87) from escalate-catalog.
BLOCKING_FINDING.why_the_reachability_analysis_missed_it: it proved the payload REACHES build-suggest-offer, which is true. It did not check what the RENDERED TEXT is sourced from downstream. By-name reads are not redirected by wiring — this repo's own documented landmine (TOPOLOGY 'Read BY NAME', LESSONS §62).
BLOCKING_FINDING.why_offline_missed_it: harness.js asserts build-suggest-offer's OUTPUT object, which is correct and annotated. No offline suite models escalate-catalog/compile-current-state's by-name re-sourcing, so the whole suite is green while the feature is inert.
BLOCKING_FINDING.fix_direction_NOT_implemented: escalate-catalog must prefer the annotated escalate_message from $input (build-suggest-offer's output) over the by-name read, or dym-annotate must write back through a node escalate-catalog already reads. Reviewer's call.
